title: Playing with Vincent Lopreston's band in Homer
summary: Harris adds a note about four weeks with an Italian leader's band outside the city, with McCullough, O'Connell and Teddy Johnson.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: Well, I'll give you another little note. Uh, when I first started, I went out to home in Louisiana and played with Vincent Lopreston. There was an Italian out there, he had a band out there. Vincent, uh, Lopreston. Lopreston. Lopreston. Lopreston. Well, he had a band out there. I stayed out there about four weeks with him, waking at a club, you know?
Were they local fellows or from New Orleans?

From New Orleans. New Orleans. George McCollum was playing trumpet and Willie O'Connell was playing, uh, things like that. I mean, I had Teddy Johnson playing alto too. Oh, Teddy, yeah. Yeah, Teddy, he was playing. Well, we only had two altos at that time. That had been alto. Yeah, he's playing tenor now. Yeah. He's waking right up that, uh, Sid Luson bourbon, I think. At some club with another line of the band.
